canonical_name: Paddle Billing MCP and Agent Skills Integration

marketplace.update_policy: Review, repin, validate, and accept a new exact upstream commit through a separate change.

mcp_servers.authentication: Interactive Google or GitHub sign-in where required by the provider.

authentication.secret_storage: Protected CrownThrive runtime or operator keychain; never Git.

mcp_servers.mutation_authority: Bounded sandbox operations only after task-level authorization.

mcp_servers.authentication: OAuth in the eligible operator context; provider permissions remain independently enforced.
mcp_servers.mutation_authority: HOLD unless the exact live operation has explicit human direction, current CrownThrive authority, provider permission, bounded scope, and readback.

skills.intent: Authenticated customer transaction and invoice history.
Products, prices, tax categories, billing intervals, and catalog seeding.
Paddle Checkout integration for web applications.
Authenticated customer portal sessions and self-service billing.
Localized pricing previews, currencies, and billing-frequency presentation.
End-to-end sandbox tests, simulated events, and integration canaries.
Webhook-driven customer and subscription state synchronization.
Authorized upgrades, downgrades, item changes, and proration handling.
Webhook receipt, signature verification, idempotency, retry, and reconciliation.

mandatory_for: Paddle subscription synchronization, cancellation, or update work
requirements: Load this wrapper and the exact matching upstream paddle-* skill before implementation.
Use paddle-docs to resolve current provider semantics when provider behavior or schemas are material.
Do not route to paddle-live by implication, convenience, or stale configuration.
Use provider search before execute when the Paddle MCP exposes those tools.
Capture bounded provider readback for every side effect.
Keep credentials and restricted customer, payment, tax, dispute, payout, and settlement data out of public source and general logs.
Fail closed if the required skill, MCP server, credential binding, exact-operation authority, or readback is unavailable.

consequential_operations: live product or price creation or mutation
required_controls: idempotency or duplicate control where applicable
non_inference: MCP connectivity does not prove Paddle account authorization.
A successful API call does not prove settlement, entitlement, tax or legal sufficiency, revenue recognition, or provider-wide authority.
A source merge does not activate live commerce.

support_export_replacement.provider_support: Use Paddle developer/support channels under the authorized CrownThrive account.
support_export_replacement.export: Export only the minimum provider records required for reconciliation; preserve restricted data outside public Git.
support_export_replacement.replacement: CrownThrive stable commerce, licensing, entitlement, and ledger identities remain provider-independent.
rollback: Disable or remove the Paddle plugin from the workspace.
Remove the three Paddle MCP entries from .mcp.json.
Revoke the Paddle live OAuth connection.
Rotate or revoke the sandbox API key.
Preserve source, provider, and incident receipts; do not erase history.
